hero.title: OEM, Customization & Export
hero.lead: Private-label manufacturing, custom packaging and export supply based on confirmed product and project requirements.

steps.title: Discuss your requirements
steps.body: We review product type, specification, packaging format, quantity and intended market.

steps.title: Packaging and design direction
steps.body: We work with you on the packaging format and design direction required for the project.

steps.title: Receive your proposal
steps.body: Our team responds with a formal commercial proposal based on confirmed requirements.

steps.title: Production and delivery coordination
steps.body: We coordinate the agreed production and delivery requirements for the project.

capabilities.body: Materials, print options, minimum order quantities and indicative lead times are confirmed for each project. Contact our team for a tailored proposal.

promises.title: Our commitments
promises.body: We support launch planning and distribution readiness while avoiding claims or timelines that have not been formally confirmed.

customisable.title: What can be customised
items: Retail, corporate, event or export requirements

qualification: Final specifications, commercial terms and timelines are confirmed in the formal proposal.
